title: Reviews on Vessel Traffic Information System to Enhance Navigational Safety
what_it_is: Reviews on Vessel Traffic Information System to Enhance Navigational Safety

sections.label: MPA Vessel Traffic Information System
sections.summary: MPA operates the VTIS, which integrates data sources to track over 10,000 vessels and manage traffic in the Singapore Strait and port waters.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) operates the Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS), which integrates data from various sources, including radars, the Automatic Identification System, closed circuit television system, Very High Frequency Communications System and ship databases, to provide an accurate and comprehensive understanding of the traffic in the Singapore Strait and Singapore port waters.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: With the capability to concurrently track more than 10,000 vessels, VTIS enables MPA to provide timely information and advice to help vessels transit safely through the Singapore Strait, as well as manage traffic within our port waters, where there are some 1,000 vessels at any one time.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: MPA carries out regular enhancements to its VTIS which was installed in 2011 and upgraded early this year.
